# fieldpro-frappe

> Open-source field service management app for Frappe and ERPNext v16 (Python 3.14, MIT
> license). It takes a service job from booking to invoice: service jobs, technician visits,
> parts from the technician's van warehouse, photos, customer signatures, a Frappe Workflow for
> approvals, offline sync, realtime updates, signed webhooks and automatic draft Sales Invoices.
> It is the backend for fieldpro-nextjs (technician app and customer portal) and ERPNext Desk,
> and the code built in UPEO Academy's course "ERPNext as a Platform".

Install with `bench get-app https://github.com/karani-gk/fieldpro-frappe`, then
`bench --site <site> install-app fieldpro`. The Frappe app is named `fieldpro`. Business rules live
in `fieldpro/services/`; API endpoints in `fieldpro/api/v1/` stay thin.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): features, quick start, demo sign-ins, project structure, course map
- [API contract](docs/API.md): endpoints, error format, response shapes, pagination, webhooks
- [Authentication](docs/AUTH.md): technician one-time code (email or SMS) and token, portal
  session with CSRF, partner OAuth2

## Related

- [fieldpro-nextjs](https://github.com/karani-gk/fieldpro-nextjs): Next.js technician app and
  customer portal for this backend
